cost: O(n²) multiplies, O(n) sums; stack 64 f64, no allocation or callbacks.
description: Sorted 1..64 nodes in [-1,1], gaps >=1e-8, finite |y|<=1e100 and query in hull. Reciprocal weights w_i=1/product_{j!=i}(x_i-x_j); output sum(w_i*y_i/(x-x_i))/sum(w_i/(x-x_i)). Exact node returns its stored y after all validation. Scale terms by maximum absolute term before summing. Size precedes nonfinite, domain, spacing, then arithmetic checks. Underflow in node products can produce Arithmetic even for valid bounded inputs.
